backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles and per-user transcription histories with permission checks for user and admin roles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files and components for Mood Music and related UI updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend source file, mainly covering audio, speech, history, and Mood Music features.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables and theme tokens for light and dark mode.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that loads the React app via main.tsx into the root element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with authentication, updated Mood Based Music branding, and tabbed UI for music, recording, transcription, TTS, and history.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout and query cache resets.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for initial profile creation with default name and Mood Based Music branding.
frontend/src/components/InfoNotice.tsx: Alert component explaining that speech features use browser-native APIs with no external services.
frontend/src/features/audio/AudioRecorde: React component for recording audio with play/pause, timers, error handling, and playback controls.
frontend/src/features/history/HistoryPan: Displays and saves transcription history, handling authentication, loading states, and transcript selection.
frontend/src/features/mood-music/catalog: Static catalog of mood-tagged audio tracks with metadata and local file URLs.
frontend/src/features/mood-music/compone: Info alert explaining that mood music uses bundled local audio files.
Grid UI for selecting a mood using image-based cards.
List of tracks with play/pause controls, highlighting the active track and displaying mood badges.
frontend/src/features/mood-music/MoodMus: Mood-based music player that filters tracks, controls playback, and shows a mini-player for the active track.
frontend/src/features/mood-music/types.t: Type definitions for moods, sort mode, and track metadata.
frontend/src/features/mood-music/useAudi: Custom hook managing audio playback state, track loading, timing, and seeking.
frontend/src/features/stt/TranscriptionP: Speech‑to‑text UI that manages listening state, transcripts, errors, and manual editing.
frontend/src/features/stt/useSpeechRecog: React hook wrapping browser speech recognition, managing listening state, transcripts, and errors.
frontend/src/features/tts/TextToSpeechPa: UI panel for selecting TTS voice, rate, and playing/stopping synthesized speech for a transcript.
frontend/src/features/tts/useSpeechSynth: React hook for speech synthesis, handling voices, rate, speaking state, and triggering or stopping TTS.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, loading/storing identity, handling login, logout, and auth-client setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React-query hooks for loading and mutating user profiles and transcription history via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light/dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, query client, identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash-based), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining dark mode, content paths, extended theme colors, animations, fonts, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s versioned state, architectural notes, required features, and image requirements for the Mood Based Music app.
